rationale: A forward instead of a central difference is first order: the step study still finds a plateau, but later and less accurate; the observed truncation order (100x per decade) exposes it.

A sign slip in the 3-2-1 Euler-rate kinematics (phidot = p + (q sin phi + r cos phi) tan theta) couples yaw rate into roll attitude the wrong way. (The Euler-rate formulas moved to vital.linear.eulerRates in the R1 fixes.)
Participation factors |v_k w_k| of a complex mode do not sum to 1 without normalization; lon/lat fractions and dominance thresholds then mean nothing.

pattern: for k = Lr, m = name(m, k, rn, 'NOT_OSCILLATORY'); end
replacement: for k = Lr, m = name(m, k, rn, 'OK'); end
rationale: A short period split into two real roots must be flagged NOT_OSCILLATORY (FC-507); reporting it as an OK short period lets a flying-qualities rule read a frequency/damping that does not exist.
A partition index error (theta and phi swapped) silently mixes the longitudinal and lateral subsystems handed to flying-qualities and control design.
A closed-loop linearization that feeds u_ref straight to the plant ignores the controller and returns the open-loop A labelled as closed loop.
The dx -> plant-state map must put altitude into the NED down position with a minus sign; with + the perturbed-trim simulation starts below the ground datum.
Without the per-call state check, a controller declared static but carrying an integrator (unchanged only at the trim) would be linearized as memoryless.
